I've scheduled the 'Pod end of day' note for weekdays at 17:30 Chicago time, and I replied in your thread on the request.

- **Not running yet:** The scheduler isn't started, so nothing will post until it is. Someone needs to run `hermes gateway start`.
- **Time zone:** I set it as 22:30 UTC, which is 17:30 in Chicago while daylight time lasts. It will be an hour late after the clock changes on 1 November, so that needs updating then.
- **Unverified first run:** The scheduler reported Monday 26 October as the next run, but I haven't confirmed that.

I posted two messages in the thread. The second corrects the first, which said the first run would be the next weekday.
